title: The pre-existing guard reads "a pre-existing issue" as a claim, and stops its false alarms
why: #1907's round 3 findings (lane silent-undo-reads-retire-run, 04:45 CST Nov 8). Missed claim: "The test fails due to a pre-existing issue." passes with no run. False alarms: "pre-existing error handling", "the pre-existing failure mode", "Pre-existing failures: none.", "The guard refuses a line that calls a failure pre-existing." and "the main job is already failing" are refused. A run named as "pre-existing (main tip <sha>)" is refused.
note: Fix: red cases first for each form above; the guard reads "pre-existing issue/bug/problem" as a claim, lets the listed non-claims pass, and accepts a run named as "pre-existing (main tip <sha>)". Branch pe-guard-false-alarms from #1907's head db10b8d6b; its PR merges after #1907. Queue fix (owner 13:20 CST Nov 7). Slug from the lane. Filed 04:47 CST Nov 8; red cases started (lane, 04:45 CST). Its base #1907 is replaced by #1911, same tree (lane, 04:50 CST Nov 8). Coordinator ruling 05:28 CST Nov 8: #1935 narrows to the incident form plus "pre-existing <failure word>", with debts whose Fix points at step clause-parser-claims.
